findings.title: host networking

normalized_input.impact:
Artifact: validation/enterprise/results/HELM_20261028T103133Z/template-enabled.yaml
Type: kubernetes
Vulnerability KSV-0009
Severity: HIGH
Message: DaemonSet 'vanian-runtime-probe' should not set 'spec.template.spec.hostNetwork' to true
Link: [KSV-0009](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0009)

reachable_path: operator enables probe and supplies immutable image/config map
Helm renders the current DaemonSet with the reported host access
cluster admission, runtime policy and actual probe behavior are not evidenced

boundary_assessment.policy_basis: No root/scoped SECURITY.md found. deploy/enterprise/kubernetes/README.md explicitly calls this an unvalidated opt-in template, not a supported Kubernetes release.

exploitability_stack_rank.rationale: Network effects may reach the node network; configured NET_ADMIN makes this the first review priority.
drivers: existing restricted capabilities and read-only mounts

evidence: Current source retains the reported condition; not merely an obsolete archive warning
counterevidence: Both components disabled by default; immutable image/configuration and explicit trust assertion required
privileged:false, allowPrivilegeEscalation:false, drop ALL except PERFMON/NET_ADMIN, no service-account token
Documentation warns that different pods/nodes do not prove separate administration
proof_gaps: No approved cluster/kernel/image/runtime policy and no runtime qualification
No supplied lower-trust entrypoint or exploit establishes a crossed supported product boundary
Generic scanner severity HIGH is retained; static presence does not establish exploitability
findings.recommended_next_step: On an approved isolated host, measure required connector coverage with and without host networking and independently verify host egress controls. Ordinary pod NetworkPolicy is not sufficient evidence.
